name: Dune: Part Three across the Oscar ballot
thesis: The film receives recognition across picture, craft, writing, and acting categories at the 99th Academy Awards.
fit: Chalamet stars in the Dune franchise; the link to this film is direct.
risk: The eight outcomes are correlated. Four craft rows have an API expected-expiration placeholder at the late 2027 backstop even though their rules concern the January 2027 nomination announcement.

rows.rationale: Best Picture is the central prestige signal.
Villeneuve nomination tests auteur recognition.
Large-scale visuals support cinematography case.
Effects craft is core to the film.
Score nomination broadens the craft slate.
Adaptation nod tests writing recognition.
Chalamet acting nod is the personal link.
Zendaya nod extends the acting case.

name: Genre cinema breaks into Best Picture
thesis: Epic, science-fiction, fantasy, animation, and superhero films earn multiple 2027 Best Picture nominations.

risk: Several selections are long shots, and all depend on the same Academy nomination cycle.

name: One AI IPO breaks through before 2027
thesis: Anthropic confirms an IPO before January 1, 2027, while six other private AI firms do not.

risk: Kalshi’s rule uses an effective S-1, IPO pricing, or exchange-assigned ticker as confirmation; it is narrower than a casual announcement. Several NO legs are expensive and may have limited upside.
